text: The ___ Report (2004), titled 'Biotechnology Research in an Age of Terrorism,' is the foundational policy document that defined the dual-use research dilemma and led to the creation of the NSABB.
explanation: The Fink Report (2004) is explicitly named as the foundational DURC policy document, and it directly led to the establishment of the National Science Advisory Board for Biosecurity (NSABB).
